question: What form does Arjuna wish to see?
premises: Arjuna accepts what the Lord said.
He wishes to see the Lord himself as supreme lord.
He asks to see the divine form.
inference: Arjuna's desire is directed toward the Lord's own divine form.
uncertainties: The exact force of evametadyathāttha is compressed.
plain_english: Thus this is as you said: I wish to see you yourself, supreme lord, your divine form, O best of persons.
